items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: Cow Cow Davenport's story to me is priceless.

ctx.x: No, I think he might have contributed. But that was not the name. But in any case, we got beautiful pictures, we got stories, priceless stories. Cow Cow Davenport's story to me is priceless. He never wrote another thing in his life.
